title: App playbook
description: One app's proven actions (recommendation §3.1). An action may appear on camera only when proven (replayed n/n from a fresh session, rules.json playbooks.replays_required). Validated by aieditor/playbook.py (hand validator, no dependency); load also rejects any action whose label or url hits the click guard deny rules.

fingerprint.description: thumbnail fingerprint of the clean start frame (filled by onboarding)

set_dressing.description: action ids run off camera, in order, to reach the start state

honest_route.description: an action id (or 'outside:<url>') that honestly shows what the narration means; null = no route (needs_primitive / A-roll)

patterns.description: regexes over a beat's text that name this feature

walls.description: regexes: page text that means a challenge/wall (stop, never record)

outside_only.description: regexes over URLs that may only be shown from the separate never-logged-in US Chrome (RULEBOOK L4)

private_selectors.description: CSS selectors always blurred (RULEBOOK C7; read by the privacy blur)

assert.description: text: value present (in the element's text when selector is set; value may hold {param}); selector: an element matches; absent: value/selector not present; theme: 'dark'|'light' by screen luminance; account: the logged-in account name is shown

selectors.description: CSS selectors, first that matches wins; 'text=<label>' finds by visible label

intents.description: regexes over a beat's text that this action honestly shows

generates.description: starts a generation (costs one of the account's generations; never replayed blindly)

requires.description: action ids run first (off camera) so that 'pre' can hold, e.g. open_plus_menu before plus_sketch
